svg.aria-label: Warehouse shares, twenty columns — Bar diagram
svg.style: background: rgb(236, 239, 244); font-family: Inter, system-ui, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.desc: Bar chart of 4 series, A, B, C and D, for 20 categories; values range from 10 to 60.
